anomalies.description: An orange sedan performs a sharp, uncontrolled turn across multiple lanes at night, crossing the centerline and nearly colliding with the recording vehicle; the maneuver appears to be a loss of control or evasive action, resulting in a near-miss incident.

A large truck on the right side of the road suddenly swerves left and collides with the dashcam vehicle, causing a violent impact and immediate dust/debris cloud. The collision occurs between frames f1 and f2, with maximum debris visible in f2–f3.

The vehicle from which the dashcam records veers sharply left off the road, collides with a roadside structure (small shed), and comes to rest in a wooded area; debris is visible on impact and the view becomes obscured by foliage/dirt.
